name.CaseQuietDays: Quiet days to close a case

help.WindowDays: The rolling window a patient's dispenses must fall in to make a pattern.
help.MinStores: Distinct pharmacies in the window that count as pharmacy hopping.
help.MaxKmPerHour: The speed between two counter dispenses above which the travel is impossible.
help.MinTravelKm: The shortest distance a too-fast leg must cover to count as travel.
help.OverlapShare: The share of the last supply still left when the same medicine is dispensed at another pharmacy (0.25 = 25%).
help.CaseQuietDays: Days with no matching dispense after which a case closes.
help.LookbackDays: Days of dispense history each run reads.

settings.savedDetail: They apply from the next run.
